rows.details: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS), Ministry of Defence, Govt of India – Station HQ (ECHS Cell) Missamari
Rs. 95,000/- (Medical Officer); Rs. 36,500/- (Nursing Assistant) – fixed remuneration
One year, renewable for an additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age, subject to performance

content_sections.heading: About ECHS Missamari
content_sections.text: The Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) works under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. This notice is issued by Station HQ (ECHS Cell) Missamari, PIN-901224, C/O 99 APO, and signed by Lieutenant Colonel VS Rawat, OIC, ECHS Polyclinic Missamari Type 'E', for Adm Comdt. Both posts are at ECHS Polyclinic Missamari.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice announces 2 vacancies in total, one for each post. The notice gives no category-wise break-up. It states that preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a minimum period of experience for either post, but the application must carry self-attested photocopies of testimonials for both educational qualification and work experience, and work experience documents must be shown at the interview. Only candidates meeting the qualitative requirements may apply. For the full terms of each post, see the official notification and the ECHS website.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Both posts are on a contractual basis at ECHS Polyclinic Missamari. The engagement is for a period of one year, with renewal for an additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age, subject to the performance of candidates and other conditions. The notice states that the terms and conditions, application forms and remunerations are given on the website www.echs.gov.in . The notice does not mention any allowances on top of the fixed remuneration.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Missamari Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The application is offline, in the format given on the ECHS website, followed by an interview at Stn HQ Missamari. Get the application format from the website www.echs.gov.in . Fill in the application in the requisite format. Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials in support of educational qualification and work experience. Prepare the application in duplicate. Submit it to OIC, Stn HQ (ECHS Cell), Missamari, so that it reaches before 1200 hrs on 19 November 2026. The notice also mentions submission by 1159 hrs on 20 November 2026, but states that any application received after 1200 hrs on 19 November 2026 will not be accepted. Report at Stn HQ Missamari for the interview on 3 December 2026 with the original documents listed below. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application in the requisite format, in duplicate Self-attested photocopies of testimonials for educational qualification Self-attested photocopies of testimonials for work experience Original certificate/mark sheet/degree of 10th/Matric Original certificate/mark sheet/degree of 10+2 Original certificate/mark sheet/degree of Graduation/Post Graduation/Diploma course Work experience documents Discharge Book, PPO and Service Records 02 passport size coloured photographs

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen. For additional details, contact Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Missamari at mobile no. 9181232705 or email [email protected] , or approach the concerned ECHS Polyclinic.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ECHS Missamari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Medical Officer and one Nursing Assistant at ECHS Polyclinic Missamari.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Missamari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications received after 1200 hrs on 19 November 2026 will not be accepted, although the notice also mentions submission by 1159 hrs on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the ECHS Missamari Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for Medical Officer is MBBS.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the ECHS Missamari Nursing Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for Nursing Assistant is GNM Diploma/Class 1 course (Armed Forces).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the ECHS Missamari Medical Officer and Nursing Assistant?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration is Rs. 95,000/- for Medical Officer and Rs. 36,500/- for Nursing Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ECHS Missamari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the application in the format on www.echs.gov.in, in duplicate with self-attested photocopies of qualification and work experience testimonials, to OIC, Stn HQ (ECHS Cell), Missamari.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the ECHS Missamari interview?
faq.answer: The interview is at Stn HQ Missamari on 3 December 2026 between 1030 hrs and 1230 hrs; candidates must report by 1000 hrs.

faq.question: Q8. Is the ECHS Missamari job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is contractual for one year, with renewal for an additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age, subject to performance and other conditions.

faq.question: Q9. Do Ex-Servicemen get preference in ECHS Missamari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states that preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the ECHS Missamari interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA is admissible.
